use_cases.title: Log into the Core Wealth Hub portal

acceptance_criteria.title: The Core Wealth Hub login page is presented at the documented URL https://core-wealth-hub.lovable.app/login.
Submitting username `Admin` and password `admin` grants administrator access to the authenticated Core Wealth Hub portal.
Submitting username `Admin` with an incorrect password does not grant authenticated Core Wealth Hub portal access.
Completing KYC verification updates the loan profile's KYC status to "Verified".
A loan profile exposes a KYC Verification tab for KYC review.
The KYC evidence set includes government-issued identification (ID/Passport).
The KYC evidence set includes proof of address.
The personal loan application workflow is available to administrators and authorized users acting on behalf of applicants.
Submitting a completed personal loan application sends the application for review.
The Loan Applications section provides a New Application entry point for starting a personal loan application.
The application blocks successful submission when borrower details are omitted.
The application blocks successful submission when the requested loan amount is omitted.
The application blocks successful submission when loan tenure is omitted.
The application blocks successful submission when income verification is omitted.
The application blocks successful submission when employment information is omitted.
An administrator can initiate a new personal loan application from Loan Applications by choosing New Application.
An authorized user can initiate a new personal loan application from Loan Applications by choosing New Application.
The system provides a global search bar that administrators can use to locate existing loan files.
The system provides a Loan Details tab that administrators can use to filter and review existing loan files.
Loan-detail search supports applicant name as a search criterion.
Loan-detail search supports application ID as a search criterion.
Loan-detail search supports phone number as a search criterion.
The current loan status search/filter control includes Pending as a supported value.
The current loan status search/filter control includes Approved as a supported value.
The current loan status search/filter control includes Rejected as a supported value.
A located loan file exposes its application history for review.
A located loan file exposes its current status for review.
Applying the Pending status filter in the Loan Details tab shows only loan records whose current status is Pending.
Applying the Approved status filter in the Loan Details tab shows only loan records whose current status is Approved.
Applying the Rejected status filter in the Loan Details tab shows only loan records whose current status is Rejected.
Searching from the global search bar by applicant name shows only loan records for the entered applicant name.
Searching from the global search bar by application ID shows only the loan record for the entered application ID.
Searching from the global search bar by phone number shows only loan records for the entered phone number.
